name: Afterborn
description: Humans with few or no body modifications. Their communities share medical knowledge, meals, and shelter supplies.

passive.name: Ordinary Courage
passive.description: Shelter medicine and practical endurance grant 20 additional maximum health.

lore: The first Afterborn were children left out of the evacuation census. Shelter cooks wrote their names on meal bowls so they would still receive rations. Their descendants keep that practice. Your lineage quests trace missing clinic records, remove ancestry checks, and follow the water supply back to Mourning Fen.

name: Lattice
tagline: People living in repairable ceramic bodies.
description: Their memories run through ceramic networks that can be repaired or copied. People who share old memories can still lead separate lives.

passive.name: Capacitive Thought
passive.description: Distributed ceramic reserves grant 20 additional maximum energy.

lore: During the Long Brownout, repair machines used damaged human records to recognize their patients. Some developed memories and wishes of their own. Tam of Nine Cups became the first recognized Lattice citizen. Your lineage quests challenge repossession and forced merging, then investigate the mineral seam used to make replacement bodies.

name: Revenant
tagline: People restored after an earlier death.
description: Revenants live in grown or constructed bodies. They may remember parts of an earlier life, and can change their instructions about future restoration.

passive.name: Borrowed Second
passive.description: Practiced threat recognition grants 3 percentage points of critical-hit chance.

lore: The first restoration vaults served workers repairing Vesper’s sea barriers. Contractors later used restoration agreements to claim those workers’ labor. Your lineage quests uncover the hidden terms, free people from collection orders, and set new consent rules while the clinics face a shortage of water and nutrients.

name: Sporebound
tagline: People living with engineered fungal partners.
description: Their fungal partners help filter toxins and support movement. Different cultures need different food and care.

passive.name: Rootstep
passive.description: Responsive muscle symbiosis increases movement speed by 8 percent.

lore: Companies developed these cultures to protect salt miners, then charged the miners to keep them alive. Workers shared recipes that ended their dependence on the licensed feed. Your lineage quests investigate that history, protect patients from seizure, and contain escaped strains that are spreading through the salt pans.
